# NexBotix

> NexBotix (https://nexbotix.online) is an AI employees platform for small and growing businesses. Each AI employee is a named agent that owns one job: sending WhatsApp campaigns and answering replies, finding local business leads, running email outreach, answering website visitors, posting to Facebook and LinkedIn, monitoring SEO and booking meetings. Pricing is credit-based: every plan includes every AI employee, and each action uses credits (1 per WhatsApp message or AI reply, 2 per lead, 50 per SEO blog post). Plans start at ₹399 a month for 2,500 credits, with a free trial of 100 credits (no credit card).

## AI Employees

- [Nexa: WhatsApp bulk message sender with AI auto-reply](https://nexbotix.online/ai-agents/whatsapp): Personalised bulk WhatsApp campaigns from Excel/CSV with 3–5 second gaps, scheduling, AI follow-ups, and AI replies with human handoff. Optional official WhatsApp Business Cloud API.
- [Scrappy: Google Maps lead scraper and AI outreach](https://nexbotix.online/ai-agents/leads): Local business leads from Google Maps and Bing Maps by niche and city, deduplicated and enriched with emails, with AI-written outreach in autopilot or co-pilot mode.
- [Mailo: AI email outreach and bulk email campaigns](https://nexbotix.online/ai-agents/email): Campaigns from Gmail, Outlook or SMTP, open and click tracking, re-targeting by segment, and AI auto-replies over IMAP.
- [Webby: AI chatbot for websites](https://nexbotix.online/ai-agents/website-chatbot): Crawls your site, answers visitors 24/7, captures leads, installs with one script tag, and can route to your own in-house AI.
- [Pagey & Linko: AI social media manager](https://nexbotix.online/ai-agents/social): Facebook Page scheduling and analytics; AI-written LinkedIn posts with AI images and approval by email.
- [Seona: AI SEO agent](https://nexbotix.online/ai-agents/seo): A ~3 KB script tracks Core Web Vitals and SEO issues per page, auto-fixes script-fixable issues, follows Google Trends and publishes AI blog posts to GitHub.
- [Schedula: appointment booking software](https://nexbotix.online/ai-agents/calendar): Booking pages with Google Calendar two-way sync, automatic Google Meet links, working hours, notice periods and website embeds.

## For developers

- REST API: send WhatsApp messages to one contact or up to 50 per request, schedule and cancel messages, send email with attachments.
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP) for Claude, Cursor, Windsurf and other MCP clients. Tools: `send_whatsapp_message`, `schedule_whatsapp_message`, `list_scheduled_messages`, `cancel_scheduled_message`, `send_email`, `get_bot_status`.
- Website chatbot JavaScript API: `window.NexBotix.open()`, `close()`, `toggle()`, `setUser()`.
- In-house AI: route chatbot conversations to your own model via webhook or a pasted cURL command, with tokens encrypted (AES-256-GCM) and fallback to the built-in AI.

## Notes

- Bulk sending on a personal WhatsApp number carries some risk of restriction; NexBotix spaces messages out and offers the WhatsApp Business Cloud API for high volume.
- Payments are processed by Razorpay.
